    nop
    lui $at, %hi(lc_enemy_types)
    addu $at, $at, $s2
    lbu $at, %lo(lc_enemy_types)($at)
    addiu $at, $at, -2
    bne $at, $zero, 2f
    sll $v0, $s2, 1
    j lc_battle_soldier
    nop
1:  sltiu $at, $s2, 100
    beq $at, $zero, 3f
    sll $v0, $s2, 1
